states.adopted: An authored profile row exists and binds this mode. Equals MOVE-C2-R01's 'S/N' cell: production qualification is still NOT ready. Never an admission grant. admission_qualified is false for every such row in this file.
states.explicitly_disabled: An identified AUTHORED prohibition applies to this profile/action/state, with its reason and the conditions that can change it preserved. Equals MOVE-C2-R01's DISABLED.
states.unresolved_q2: The required authored profile is missing or incomplete, or required implementation/qualification is missing. Equals MOVE-C2-R01's AUTHORED_PROFILE_NOT_READY and the code's UNPROFILED / MODE_NOT_PROFILED. This is NOT a prohibition and NOT a claim that a finished profile exists.

validator_rules: rows MUST contain exactly 16 species keys; each MUST contain exactly the 3 life_stages; each MUST contain exactly the 6 modes. 288 leaf entries, no more and no fewer.
Every leaf value MUST resolve to a key of row_classes.
row_classes[*].state MUST be one of the three declared states.
No row_class may set admission_qualified true while any of its blocking_q2_slots is unfilled.

A supplied policy or binding value MUST cite an adopted ruling; unresolved numeric and measurement fields remain explicitly empty (MOVE-C3-R01 §7, which retires PR123's proposal-lane all-null invariant). In THIS revision no slot was supplied: every q2_slot value MUST still be null and q2_slots_with_values MUST be 0. A non-null value without a cycle3_disposition.decision_source naming an adopted ruling is a lane violation.

blocking_contract MUST reference a blocking_contracts key whose kind is 'admission'. A row whose blocking_contract has kind 'presentation' is a validation FAILURE: MOVE-DEP-R03 forbids a presentation gap gating admission.
presentation_gaps entries MUST NOT appear in any row's blocking_contract or evidence_absent.
totals MUST equal the recomputed counts over rows.

modes MUST contain exactly six entries with ids 0..5 and the compiled keys. Protection is a connection property, not a seventh mode: CLIMB protection cases are recorded as climb_action_variants beneath a CLIMB row class and never as an added, duplicated or discarded mode row.

A row_class whose state is explicitly_disabled MUST name an authored_prohibition that resolves to an authored_prohibitions[*].id, and that prohibition MUST record conditions_that_can_change_it. A missing profile, envelope, recovery definition or contact is never recorded this way: it is unresolved_q2 (MOVE-C3-R01 §5).
Every cycle3_disposition MUST carry a decision_source naming an adopted ruling and MUST NOT introduce a dimension, cost, speed, air budget, depth or clearance value.
admission_qualified MUST be false for every row_class and totals.admission_qualified MUST be 0. No measured envelope exists.

Every q2 slot id a row_class cites in blocking_q2_slots or resolved_q2_slots MUST exist in q2_slots, and no slot may appear in both lists for the same row: a slot is either still blocking that row or answered for it, never both.
mode_scope_note: system_scope is a settlement-scope statement, never a per-species capability grant. SET-MOVE-001 §1 excludes 'a blanket innate ability table inferred from species or slide lists'; MOVE-C2-R01: 'No table entry grants an innate ability.' There is no FLIGHT mode; sparrow and kestrel stay grounded under MOVE-DEP-R03, which is a scope exclusion and not a prohibition on any of the six modes. MOVE-C3-R01 §5 additionally protects the six existing mode ids: record action and protection variants beneath CLIMB rather than duplicating or discarding mode rows, and do not add a fourth catalog state meaning 'policy-approved therefore ready'.

cycle3_disposition.settled: FORD_WALK means supported walking across the explicitly authored GDD §5.1 ford, using the authoritative world_init mask; it is not swimming and not a generic 'any sufficiently shallow water' predicate. cycle3_disposition.settled: Yes, and wider than the question asked. DEC-032 already forbids 'hazardous expeditions' as well as hazardous work and excavation, which PR123 omitted. New deliberate CHILD travel through a HAZ-001 dangerous connection is prohibited irrespective of intent: work, needs, play or learning, a direct move, an expedition or accompanying an adult. Voluntary SWIM_SURFACE and DIVE are prohibited for all sixteen species. Unprotected CLIMB entry is prohibited; a qualified HAZ-003 protected connection with a compatible child profile is eligible for nonproductive ordinary access. Consent, a direct order, an escort's presence and a skill value cannot override any of it. This is a NEW-ENTRY restriction: recovery and rescue of a child already in danger is preserved and is a different state.

authored_prohibitions.scope: work and job class, NOT a traversal mode row
authored_prohibitions.subject: CHILD hazardous work, hazardous expeditions and excavation
authored_prohibitions.conditions_that_can_change_it: None stated. PC-04 owns CHILD and ELDER activation. A safe travel path does not make a productive assignment legal, and a helping animation may not secretly produce inventory or production XP.
authored_prohibitions.note: Still deliberately NOT a species x mode row: this is a work and job class. MOVE-C3-R01 §2 restores DEC-032's omitted 'hazardous expeditions' clause, which PR123 narrowed to hazardous work and excavation, and answers Q2-32 separately as a TRAVEL policy recorded under PROHIB-CHILD-HAZARDOUS-ENTRY. Child excavation remains prohibited even though properly supported dry excavation adds no HAZ danger flag.

authored_prohibitions.scope: New deliberate CHILD entry into a HAZ-001 dangerous connection. A life-stage and action policy applied uniformly to every species, NOT a species restriction and NOT a seventh mode.
authored_prohibitions.subject: Voluntary CHILD SWIM_SURFACE and voluntary CHILD DIVE, for all sixteen species; and CHILD entry onto an UNPROTECTED CLIMB connection. Prohibited irrespective of whether the intention is work, needs, play or learning, a direct move, an expedition or accompanying an adult.
cannot_be_overridden_by: an escort's presence: no escort grants a forbidden mode, and an accompanying adult confers no permission
a rope icon, a nearby adult or a caller boolean asserting a connection is protected
authored_prohibitions.conditions_that_can_change_it: A qualified HAZ-003 PROTECTED climb connection with its actual support and rescue arrangement, plus a compatible CHILD profile, makes protected CLIMB eligible for nonproductive ordinary access: see row_classes.RC_CHILD_CLIMB_CONDITIONAL. Nothing currently lifts the voluntary swim or dive prohibition; revisiting DEC-032's hazardous-expedition boundary needs its own ruling and owner.
does_not_imply: disappearance of a child already in danger
a ban on recovering a child already in danger
permission to schedule hazardous leisure travel under a rescue label
that a child becomes a productive rescue worker
authored_prohibitions.note: 32 CHILD rows (16 species x SWIM_SURFACE, DIVE) carry the definite prohibition. The 16 CHILD CLIMB rows are conditional on the connection's declared HAZ-003 case and are NOT wholly disabled; protection is a connection property, not a mode. Protected access to a platform does not authorize a productive job at its landing.

authored_prohibitions.scope: action- and state-conditioned, applicable to every species; never species-wide
authored_prohibitions.subject: Action- and state-conditioned refusals that are genuinely AUTHORED prohibitions: through travel in an incomplete, unsupported or water-intersecting excavation; dangerous entry without consent or at health<70, hunger<=3500, rest<4000, or with an active untreated injury; a dive whose declared round trip is not finite and complete or whose available_air is below T+300; a surface swim or climb executed without the float/return, submergence-recovery, protected-support or fall-landing condition its connection declares; removal of an occupied passage, the only safe exit, a protected air landing or descent, or rescue support; and free flight, branch-gap jumps, underwater attacks, moving vessels and unsupported collapse/flood shortcuts.
authored_prohibitions.conditions_that_can_change_it: Each is lifted by its own stated condition being satisfied at admission time: consent and the HAZ-001 thresholds, a complete finite round trip with a protected breathable endpoint, the declared float/return and recovery, the declared protected support or fall landing, and a remaining safe exit. None is lifted by authoring alone.
authored_prohibitions.note: MOVE-C3-R01 §5 corrects PR123 2.4: the ABSENCE of an authored float/return posture, airless-recovery binding, breathable-endpoint set, protected-support definition or fall landing is NOT recorded here. Missing authoring is AUTHORED_PROFILE_NOT_READY and is listed under missing_definitions_not_prohibitions. Runtime entry refuses either way; lack of authoring is not an authored inability.

species_wide_prohibition_note: MOVE-C2-R01: 'Species-wide DISABLED rows for the four requested modes: zero established by current policy.' Still zero after MOVE-C3-R01. PROHIB-CHILD-HAZARDOUS-ENTRY applies to every species, which is exactly why it is not a species restriction: it is conditioned on life stage and action, no species is singled out or exempted, and MOVE-C3-R01 §3 grants the same ordinary-access policy to all sixteen. A missing profile is never recorded here.

RC_ADULT_FORD_STARTER.ford_semantics: MOVE-C3-R01 §1: FORD_WALK is supported walking across the authored GDD §5.1 ford, enforced PER SEGMENT from the authoritative mask (a segment with either endpoint on a ford cell requires it), not stored as an unused route-wide label. It inherits the existing ground speed, carry and 10/14 baseline cost treatment with no surcharge, and it is not dangerous entry. The 128u water/floor difference is not a per-species maximum wading depth and the 640u land/floor difference is not a step capability. Today movement.gd still writes _cursor_mode once at _attach_route(); the explicit per-segment field, API and version change is Movement/G02's.

RC_ADULT_CLIMB.note: Protected-climb build cost and unprotected-climb consequence formulas are settled under HAZ-003. The arcs, landings and drops they price do not exist.
RC_ADULT_CLIMB.climb_protection_case: Q2-21 (MOVE-C3-R01 §4): every climb connection declares exactly one HAZ-003 recovery case, protected or unprotected, and danger follows that case rather than the mode id. Qualified protected climbing infrastructure may serve ordinary access with no species-exclusive veto (MOVE-C3-R01 §3); the unprotected case still owes its species/profile assignment and costs, with HAZ conditions mandatory. Neither case is authored yet, so the row stays unresolved_q2.

RC_ADULT_TUNNEL.note: Walking a completed supported tunnel is ordinary access and is independent of excavation capability (MOVE-C3-R01 §3). ECON-001's 1024u priced cube is not a navigation voxel or body envelope. Digging creates space; travelling through finished space is separate. An unfinished void cannot borrow this permission.

RC_CHILD_NONHAZ.refuses_today: LIFE_STAGE_NOT_PROFILED (movement.gd PROFILE_LIFE_STAGE is four entries, all ADULT)
RC_CHILD_NONHAZ.note: Release immobility for CHILD is NOT adopted and no adult coefficient is substituted. MOVE-C3-R01 §§2-3: ground, the authored ford and completed supported tunnel access are not prohibited by child stage alone and are permitted as NONPRODUCTIVE access; the actual CHILD profile and PC-04 needs, care and routine rules remain required, so the row stays unresolved_q2. A child still cannot be assigned an ordinary productive job even when its travel path is safe, and child excavation remains prohibited. The missing rig variant (PG-RIG-STAGE-VARIANT) is a presentation gap and is deliberately not listed as a blocker.

RC_ELDER_NONHAZ.note: DEC-032 requires active individual elder roles and says age alone is neither helplessness nor a universal productivity penalty. No elder coefficient is proposed. MOVE-C3-R01 §3 answers Q2-33: no ELDER-only mode veto, age penalty or stricter danger threshold in release 1. The same authored action policies and HAZ thresholds apply to the elder's actual state. This did NOT publish an elder profile: a missing elder profile returns not-ready and is never replaced by adult coefficients.

RC_CHILD_WATER_PROHIBITED.prohibited_action: New deliberate CHILD entry into voluntary SWIM_SURFACE or voluntary DIVE, for any of the sixteen species, for any intention including work, needs, play or learning, a direct move, an expedition or accompanying an adult.
RC_CHILD_WATER_PROHIBITED.decision_source: MOVE-C3-R01 §2; DEC-032 'no ordinary productive labor assignments, hazardous expeditions or excavation jobs'; HAZ-001 dangerous-action classification
RC_CHILD_WATER_PROHIBITED.conditions_that_can_change_it: None currently. Consent, a direct order, an escort's presence and a skill value cannot override it. Revisiting DEC-032's hazardous-expedition boundary requires its own ruling and owner.
RC_CHILD_WATER_PROHIBITED.not_covered_by_this_row: recovery_is_not_entry -- rescue or recovery of a child ALREADY in danger is a different state and is preserved.
RC_CHILD_WATER_PROHIBITED.refuses_today: LIFE_STAGE_NOT_PROFILED, and independently of that the CHILD action policy
RC_CHILD_WATER_PROHIBITED.note: The state is explicitly_disabled by AUTHORED POLICY. blocking_contract records the separately unmet admission contract that would also refuse today; clearing that contract would not lift the prohibition, and the prohibition is not evidence that a profile is unnecessary. This is a life-stage and action policy applied to every species, not a species-wide prohibition.

RC_CHILD_CLIMB_CONDITIONAL.replaces: RC_CHILD_HAZ's unconditional grouping of the whole CLIMB mode (MOVE-C3-R01 §2)

unprotected.conditions_that_can_change_it: Only the connection itself becoming a qualified HAZ-003 protected connection. A rope icon, a nearby adult or a caller boolean cannot turn an unprotected connection into a protected one.

requires: a qualified protected connection carrying HAZ-003's actual support and rescue arrangement
PC-04 needs, care and routine rules
protected.does_not_authorize: a productive job at the landing -- protected access to a platform is not an orchard-work assignment, and a helping animation may not produce inventory or production XP

RC_CHILD_CLIMB_CONDITIONAL.refuses_today: LIFE_STAGE_NOT_PROFILED; and no connection declares a HAZ-003 protection case yet (Q2-21)
RC_CHILD_CLIMB_CONDITIONAL.note: The row is NOT wholly disabled: protection is a property of the connection, not a seventh mode, and MOVE-C3-R01 §2 forbids marking all 48 CHILD dangerous-mode rows disabled. The whole-row state stays unresolved_q2 because the permitted protected variant has no published child profile and no connection declares its recovery case. CLIMB is not classified dangerous by mode alone.

totals.cross_check: adult_connected_rows_not_ready = 64 still matches MOVE-C2-R01 'all 64 adult species/mode combinations'; adult_ground_ford_adopted = 8 still matches its four S/N species across two modes. New under MOVE-C3-R01 §2: explicitly_disabled = 32 = 16 species x {SWIM_SURFACE, DIVE} at CHILD, exactly the ruling's '32 CHILD species/mode rows have a definite prohibition', and child_climb_conditional = 16 is reported separately rather than folded into that figure -- 32 + 16 = the 48 rows the ruling forbids marking wholly disabled. ordinary_access_policy_rows = 144 = 16 species x 3 stages x {GROUND_WALK, FORD_WALK, TUNNEL_WALK} under MOVE-C3-R01 §3. admission_qualified stays 0: no measured envelope exists.

explicitly_not_proposed: Any body, gear, cargo or swept dimension in any unit.
Any clearance class for any profile.
Any mode speed, entry/exit/turn duration or edge cost.
Any air budget, depth, elevation, level count or level spacing.
Any route recentring, alternative root offset, or change to the (+256,+256) production placement.
Any species-wide prohibition, and any inference of incompatibility from a missing profile.
Any CHILD or ELDER coefficient, and any adult fallback for a non-adult stage.
Any save schema version, packed column, arena capacity or byte-ledger change.
Any change to DEC-039 heights, DEC-040 direction, or the ECON/HAZ parameter set.
Any per-species maximum water depth inferred from the ford's 128u water/floor difference, and any step height, ramp or vertical transfer inferred from the 640u land/floor difference.
Any ENABLED row, any admission_qualified row, and any fourth catalog state meaning 'policy-approved therefore ready'.
Any seventh mode. Climb protection is a connection property recorded as a variant beneath the CLIMB row.
Any ADULT or ELDER species permission for SWIM_SURFACE, voluntary DIVE or unprotected CLIMB; MOVE-C3-R01 §3 leaves those to Q2-31.
Any movement-XP field, learned-unlock bit or acquisition system; MOVE-C3-R01 §3 answers Q2-34 by declaring eligibility in versioned profiles instead.
revision_note: Schema 2 is this planning register's own shape change: q2_slots may now carry a cycle3_disposition, row_classes may carry ordinary_access_policy, authored_prohibition and climb_action_variants, and rows may resolve to the prohibited/conditional CHILD classes. It is NOT the movement envelope input schema 2 adopted by MOVE-C3-R01 §6, which versions docs/planning/movement_envelope_schema.json under a different owner, and it is not a save schema version.
q2_advancement_note: MOVE-C3-R01 settles named policy slots. MOVE-G01/Q2 remains OPEN for complete mode and species cost rows, ADULT/ELDER water and unprotected-climb permissions, real source-bound measured envelopes, support and contact producers, and the associated G02 contracts. No movement gate is closed by this revision.
q2_open_slot_note: The 22 slots with no cycle3_disposition are untouched by MOVE-C3-R01: Q2-01-03, Q2-05-14, Q2-17, Q2-20, Q2-22, Q2-25-30. They are real measurement, geometry and cost authoring work, not choices a policy paragraph fills, and they stay explicitly empty.

missing_definitions_not_prohibitions.rule: A required missing profile, measured envelope, recovery definition or actual contact is AUTHORED_PROFILE_NOT_READY. Runtime entry still refuses, but lack of authoring is not an authored inability and must never be filed with the known prohibited actions.

items.subject: The declared float/return posture and submergence recovery for surface swimming
The set of protected breathable dive endpoints and the dive air-profile binding
The per-connection protected/unprotected climb recovery case and its fall landing, trajectory and drop
The combined rescue envelope, patient compatibility and pickup/set-down contacts
Generalized wading depth and bank/step/shore transition geometry and timing beyond the authored ford
CHILD and ELDER stage profiles and PC-04 rules for the access their stage policy now permits

recovery_is_not_entry.statement: The CHILD prohibition is a NEW-ENTRY restriction. A child being rescued from water is not a child entering water: they are different states and the register records them separately. No row in `rows` describes recovery.
preserved_for_an_existing_distressed_occ: execution of its validated committed return or recovery path
recovery_is_not_entry.requirements: A rescue needs the combined envelope, real support and airway handling, and rescuer eligibility. A carried child is a patient in HAZ-004's checked relationship, not a self-swimming actor.
grants_nothing: no scheduling of hazardous leisure travel under a rescue label
no child rescue job: children do not become productive rescue workers
no air refill and no teleport
